messages:
Maya: Quick sync — AcmeHealth is pushing for Insights UI in their pilot. They want 1) per-route retention controls, 2) a trace sampling UI, and 3) export hooks to S3. Need to decide what we take for beta vs backlog.
Ethan: cc @Priya — does the current PRD cover per-route retention or just org-level?
Priya: Right now PRD only has org-level tiers (7d / 30d / 90d). Per-route was scoped as future work because of storage/selector complexity.
Lukas: If AcmeHealth needs per-route for compliance, we can ship a constrained version: UI to tag routes for "extended retention" with enforced limits (max 180d) and metrics to estimate storage impact.
Maya: That could be a good compromise. Proposal: Beta includes org tiers + opt-in route tags (admin-only) + trace sampling slider (global + per-route override). Export hooks to S3 as alpha (manual export only). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Ethan: Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) Admin can enable route retention tags and set retention up to 180d; 2) System shows estimated storage delta before applying; 3) Trace sampling slider persists and can be overridden per-route; 4) Manual export produces gzipped ndjson to S3 via customer role.
Priya: Edge cases: what if a route has data spanning multiple retention windows (e.g., tag removed mid-period)? We should define cleanup: removal does not purge past data until previous retention expires, and changes are effective only forward.
Lukas: Also need quota guardrails: if route tags cause >20% of org storage increase, block and require confirmation + billing approval. Add a warning modal in UI.
Maya: UX note — show a simple cost estimate card: "Estimated monthly storage change: +$X". Keep numbers fuzzy to avoid surprises, link to detailed calc.
Ethan: Implementation note: backend needs per-route retention metadata and a TTL job keyed by route_id + created_at. We'll store route-level override in metadata table. Pseudocode: 
```
PATCH /api/v1/routes/:id
body: { retention_days: 180 }
// backend stores metadata.retention_override
// TTL worker calculates delete_after = created_at + retention_days
```
Priya: Testing & rollout: canary to 10% orgs for 48h, monitor delete-job error rate, storage delta, and UI latency. Add regression tests for retention churn.
ConsoleBot: deploy scheduled: canary 1719900000, full 1719980000 (automated message)
Maya: Decision (tentative): Ship beta as proposed. Action items: @Priya draft PRD update with acceptance criteria + edge cases, @Ethan add API contract + TTL job ticket, @Lukas wire up cost estimate. We'll sync Wednesday EOD.
Ethan: Ack. I'll add API contract to the spec and include example S3 export response schema.
Priya: I'll sketch the PRD update today and drop it in the doc for review.
Lukas: I'll prototype the estimate calc and mock the warning modal.
Maya: Thanks — if anyone hears urgent from AcmeHealth, flag here. Otherwise I'll lock the scope when Priya posts the doc. :thumbsup:
